item.title: Re: SCP Idea : Speedrun of Life 100%
item.content:encoded:
This feels like an SCP from Series 1 or 2. Will you be writing in that style of an article? To me, this is a personal bucket list of a person that the Foundation is trying to contain. My question is, "how would the Foundation contain such an anomaly?" The anomaly is trying to do a 100% speedrun of life and it's immortal. What would happen when or if the anomaly completes the speedrun? I have three things I'd like to acknowledge.

1) For the reader side of things, what does life really have to offer? Your hook can be as long as it can be, but you'll have to keep the reader engaged with this.

2) The anomaly itself is rather interesting, and you could do a lot with this character. Will they crack after doing so much to complete his life? Character growth is something you could look into for this character.

3) The Foundation is trying to contain this supposedly humanoid anomaly; how will they go about containing it? Suppose one of his goal is to be contained by the SCP Foundation. Will they keep him contained, or break the Masquerade (considering it wasn't broken)?

You have a pretty solid idea for an SCP! Bounce off more ideas from people, and check the IRC chat for the Critters. Gook luck with your SCP!

item.title: Re: SCP Idea : Speedrun of Life 100%
item.content:encoded: Cool idea man, sure is still a super draft but im sure that you can build some good stuff with this idea.

item.title: SCP Idea : Speedrun of Life 100%
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: An ongoing stream of an immortal entity's first person perspective titled "LIFE SPEEDRUN 100% GLITCHLESS." . Every day during the stream, the entity in question does something seemingly random that hasn't been done before on the stream.

Central Narrative: The narrative will be told through a series of logs recording what the anomaly is doing in the ongoing stream whilst a dispatched MTF team is using the information within the stream to locate and contain the SCP.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The immortal anomaly attempts to do literally everything life has to offer.

Additional Notes: N/A
